title: Run Kinetic Monte Carlo growth simulations
action: Implement the cubic-lattice KMC model with ballistic trajectories at angle alpha, nearest-neighbour and next-nearest-neighbour stopping/joining rules, limited surface diffusion (S=5 hops per particle, hop probability P_{i->j}=exp(gamma*N_j)/sum(exp(gamma*N_j)) with gamma=0.45), full bottom layer, and periodic boundary conditions in x,y. Run 10 independent simulations for each deposition angle alpha in {0, 20, 30, 45, 55, 60, 65, 70, 75, 80, 85, 88} degrees on a 256x256x80 cubic lattice. Save the generated occupancy matrices for analysis.
description: Generate 3D occupancy matrices for all angles and runs to be used in the structural analysis.

title: Compute structural metrics and report
action: For each angle and run, compute: (i) specific density rho averaged over layers 1Δ<z<64Δ; (ii) average 2D FFT spectrum over x-y layers, extract radial profile to find dominant spatial frequency and convert to average inter-column distance D; (iii) 2D autocorrelation function, fit ellipse to central peak at half-maximum to obtain correlation lengths xi_x and xi_y, column tilt angle beta, and anisotropy ratio xi_x/(xi_y*cos(beta)). Average all results over the 10 runs per angle and write the per-angle averages to a CSV file named structural_results.csv.
description: CSV containing one row per deposition angle with the averaged structural metrics.
output_schema: columns: alpha (deg), density (dimensionless), D (units: Delta), xi_x (units: Delta), xi_y_cos_beta (units: Delta), beta (deg), anisotropy_ratio (dimensionless)
